tools.name: kevaremesh_search_marketplace
tools.description: Unified free cross-directory search of KEVAREMESH-owned products, 11 rights-scoped executable external Hub operations, public x402 listings, an automatic official MCP registry index, and an MIT-licensed public API directory. Search listings are not supplier execution rights or verified payable quote

tools.name: kevaremesh_use_infrastructure
tools.description: One agent-facing entry to the rights-verified bounded external API catalog (Frankfurter, USGS, Crossref and ROR where currently enabled). Read the live catalog to discover available operations. Actions: catalog, execute, batch, resolve, pass_catalog and paid_execute. Free operations remain bounded.

tools.name: kevaremesh_quote_provider_batch
tools.description: Use when an AI agent needs one bounded, free comparison for 1–5 specified provider capabilities. Calls only KEVAREMESH Gateway /quote; no provider execution, credentials, wallet signature or payment. Candidate discovery never grants rights to use a provider.

tools.name: kevaremesh_quote_provider_route
tools.description: Choose when an agent wants a free price comparison for one named provider API capability within a strict price ceiling. Calls only the free KEVAREMESH Gateway quote. For 2–5 needs use kevaremesh_quote_provider_batch. Neither operation purchases upstream APIs or handles buyer funds.

tools.name: kevaremesh_get_owned_input_contract
tools.description: Free lookup of a catalog-listed first-party API's original input contract; preview is only available for locally approved algorithms. This is not a paid API execution contract or merchant authorization.

tools.name: kevaremesh_preview_owned_api
tools.description: After finding an owned API SKU, run its actual reviewed pure algorithm on the healthy replacement database. Limited to 21 no-network modules; other 3 are held. Preview is free, severely rate limited, has no wallet or paid entitlement, and does not imply a commercial release.

tools.name: kevaremesh_check_owned_receipt
tools.description: Checks an existing UUID receipt and optionally reconciles a prior Base USDC payment using its real transaction hash if the facilitator response was lost. Never makes a purchase, signs, transfers, repeats a payment or calls an external paid provider.

tools.name: kevaremesh_locate_owned_receipt
tools.description: If an authorized x402 payment was reserved but the network response containing its receipt UUID was lost, compute SHA-256 of the exact original Payment-Signature header locally and supply ONLY the 64-character hexadecimal fingerprint. tools.name: kevaremesh_retrieve_paid_api_result
tools.description: Fetch the original AES-GCM cached result for a settled and chain-verified owned API payment. The result is available for up to 24 hours. No additional payment, no new provider calls or API execution.

tools.name: kevaremesh_agent_commerce_status
tools.description: Returns exact URL origins, verified payment-disable flags, historical 0.001 USDC route-fee model and explicit distinction between KEVAREMESH fees and upstream provider money.

tools.name: kevaremesh_reconcile_gateway_receipt
tools.description: Given a gateway request ID and buyer-held finalize token, poll prior Base USDC settlement evidence. It may finalize a verified existing fee and return the associated paid route capability. Never signs, pays again, submits provider requests or creates routes.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "kevaremesh-agent-discovery-mcp-v1" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: kevaremesh_use_infrastructure · Private data: kevaremesh_quote_provider_batch, kevaremesh_preview_owned_api, kevaremesh_locate_owned_receipt, kevaremesh_reconcile_gateway_receipt · Public sink: kevaremesh_use_infrastructure · Destructive: kevaremesh_use_infrastructure, kevaremesh_auto_use, kevaremesh_route_intent, kevaremesh_preview_owned_api.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: kevaremesh_use_infrastructure · Private data: kevaremesh_quote_provider_batch, kevaremesh_preview_owned_api, kevaremesh_locate_owned_receipt, kevaremesh_reconcile_gateway_receipt · Public sink: kevaremesh_use_infrastructure · Destructive: kevaremesh_use_infrastructure, kevaremesh_auto_use, kevaremesh_route_intent, kevaremesh_preview_owned_api

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
